description: Scan a document BEFORE the agent reads it for hidden instructions: PDF (invisible/white/microscopic/off-page text, annotations, metadata, JavaScript), DOCX/XLSX/PPTX (hidden runs/sheets/rows/slides, speaker notes, comments, remote templates, DDE), HTML, Markdown. Returns allow|review|block and optional visible-only safe_text. Max 3 MB. Paid x402 $0.004 USDC on Base (unsupported/unparseable files are not charged).

path.description: Local file path (read by this MCP server on your machine)

name: docshield_scan
